description: A side-by-side connected thicket of leafy bushes, a SINGLE dense sprawling low shrub with multiple overlapping leafy crowns and fern fronds, jagged organic outline. Foliage fills the entire object with leaves, branches and small pale flowers. Three tiny grey mossy rocks peep out at its base. Wide horizontal silhouette, no symmetry. Original Thai shaman MMORPG pixel art, dark moss green leaves, muted jade, cream blossoms. Low elevated top-down camera, detailed crisp pixel art. Transparent background. This is ONLY a shrub sprite: not a landscape scene. No grass floor, no soil, no ground, no clearing, no ring, no garden bed, no border, no container, no trees, no platform, no path.
